title: What undoes adding 9?
text: The variable has 9 added to it. The inverse operation is subtraction of 9, and it has to happen on both sides or the two sides stop being equal. A common mistake is to subtract 9 from the left only, or to add 9 to 14. Which operation undoes $$+ 9$$?

title: Apply it to the right side
text: The left side becomes $$x$$. The right side becomes $$14 - 9$$. What is $$14 - 9$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$x + 9 = 14$$. Subtract 9 from both sides: $$x = 5$$. Check: $$5 + 9 = 14$$. Common mistake: adding 9 to 14 and answering 23. General rule: undo addition by subtracting the same number from both sides. Then substitute to check.
